references.text: Aaron shall make atonement on the altar once a year with the blood of the sin offering. This is an eternal statute that establishes the annual atonement ritual.
The tenth day of the seventh month is the Day of Atonement. You shall humble yourselves and present a fire offering to the Lord. This describes the annual Day of Atonement.
On the tenth day of the seventh month you shall sound the trumpet. On the Day of Atonement the trumpet shall sound throughout the land. This refers to the same annual festival.
Regulations concerning offerings on the Day of Atonement, the tenth day of the seventh month, including the sin offering for atonement.
The high priest enters the inner room once a year, not without blood which he offers for himself and for the sins of the people. This refers to the annual atonement in Leviticus 16.
Christ did not need to offer himself many times, as the high priest enters the sanctuary year after year with foreign blood. This contrasts the annual atonement with Christ's single sacrifice.

The law, with its repeated offerings presented year after year, can never make perfect those who draw near. The blood of animals cannot take away sins. This comments on the limitations of the annual atonement.
